criteria.name: LLM Explanations & Prompt Engineering
criteria.guidance: Assess clear borrower-risk explanations, prompt design, grounded outputs, and avoidance of unsupported claims.

criteria.name: RAG: Ingestion/Retrieval/Grounding
criteria.guidance: Assess document ingestion, chunking, embeddings/retrieval, relevant context, citations or evidence grounding, and limitations.

criteria.name: Text-to-SQL & Query Safety
criteria.guidance: Assess natural-language-to-SQL correctness, schema awareness, read-only/safe execution controls, and validation.

criteria.name: AI Agent Orchestration
criteria.guidance: Assess routing/orchestration among relevant agents/tools, state flow, error handling, and useful end-to-end behavior.

criteria.name: Evaluation & Responsible AI
criteria.guidance: Assess test cases, quality/safety evaluation, privacy, fairness, transparency, human oversight, and limitations.
